sample.text: FSM_Autopilot shall always satisfy (state = ap_maneuver_state & standby & good) => STATE = ap_standby_state
when emergency_button the liquid_mixer shall immediately satisfy ! valve_1
Euler shall always satisfy c1xc1Transpose = 1.0 & c2xc2Transpose = 1.0 & c3xc3Transpose = 1.0

whenever (autopilot_engaged & !hdg) & preBool(false, roll_angle - roll_cmd - preReal(roll_angle - roll_cmd, roll_angle - roll_cmd) <= epsilon) Autopilot shall immediately satisfy absReal(roll_angle - roll_cmd) <= 1.0
when emergency_button the liquid_mixer shall immediately satisfy ! stirring_motor
Euler shall always satisfy DCM321_21 = (- cos(phi) * sin(psi) + sin(phi) * sin(theta) * cos(psi))
SWIM shall always satisfy ((lowSpeedWarningAllowed = 1.0  & vehAirPress < warningTrigForMinPress) => swimGet_AgcasLowSpeedWarn = E_SWIM_WARNING_ON)
Regulator shall never satisfy persisted(100,hcvdt_cmd_fcs_fps2 > 32.0)
FSM shall always  satisfy (senstate = sen_nominal_state & !request) => SENSTATE = sen_transition_state
NN shall for 200 secs satisfy ( x = xt & y = yt  => absReal(zt - z) <= 0.01)
NN shall for 200 secs satisfy DeltaZDividedByYt <= 10.0 & DeltaZDividedByYt >= -35.0
RollAutopilot shall always satisfy (TurnKnob >= 3.0 | TurnKnob <= -3.0) & (TurnKnob <= 30.0 | TurnKnob >= -30.0) => roll_hold_reference = TurnKnob
Regulator shall always satisfy pitch_command_acceleration <= 50.0
NLGuidance shall always satisfy Vv * yout > 0
in roll_hold  mode RollAutopilot shall immediately satisfy (-30.0 >= roll_angle | roll_angle >= 30.0) => roll_hold_reference = 30.0 * sign_roll_angle

TriplexSignalMonitor shall always satisfy (single_fail_reported & (((!(absReal(ia - ib) > Tlevel) & (absReal(ib - ic) > Tlevel) & (absReal(ia - ic) > Tlevel)) | ((absReal(ia - ib) > Tlevel) & !(absReal(ib - ic) > Tlevel) & (absReal(ia - ic) > Tlevel)) | ((absReal(ia - ib) > Tlevel) & (absReal(ib - ic) > Tlevel) & !(absReal(ia - ic) > Tlevel))) & preInt(0,PC) <= PCLimit & PC > 0) => set_val = preReal(0.0,set_val))
The vehicle shall always satisfy rearprop xor hover_control_mode

Euler shall always satisfy DCMxDCMTranspose_11 = 1.0 & DCMxDCMTranspose_12 = 0.0 & DCMxDCMTranspose_13 = 0.0 & DCMxDCMTranspose_21 = 0.0 & DCMxDCMTranspose_22 = 1.0 & DCMxDCMTranspose_23 = 0.0 & DCMxDCMTranspose_31 = 0.0 & DCMxDCMTranspose_32 = 0.0 & DCMxDCMTranspose_33 = 1.0
when timer_60sec_expire, the liquid_mixer shall until (timer_120sec_expire | emergency_button) satisfy valve_2
The vehicle shall within 16 ticks satisfy lift_mode = thrust_borne
The vehicle shall always satisfy kias >= 0.0
Upon lift_mode = wing_borne & kias > 90.0 the vehicle shall until lift_mode = wing_borne & kias <= 90.0 satisfy lift_mode = wing_borne
Tustin_Integrator shall always satisfy normalv3 => yout = timeStep * 0.5 * ( xin + xinpv ) + ypv
The vehicle shall always satisfy FTP | absReal(preReal(0.0,wind_speed) - wind_speed) <= 10.0
The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, fcs & kias >= 30.0) then fcs
The vehicle shall within 13 ticks satisfy lift_mode = thrust_borne

Upon lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne & kias <= 40.0 & (!hover_control_mode | kgs > 20.0) the vehicle shall until lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne & (kias > 40.0 | (kgs <= 20.0 & hover_control_mode)) satisfy lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne
The vehicle shall always satisfy kias = kgs
Euler shall always satisfy DCM321_11 = cos(theta) * cos(psi)
when emergency_button, the liquid_mixer shall immediately satisfy ! valve_0
